I can help you plan it end-to-end. To get started, I need a few details:

1) What city and zoo are you planning to visit?
2) What grade/age are your students, and about how many people total (students + chaperones)?
3) Do you already have a target date, or is it more of a date range (e.g., any weekday in May)?
4) What time window do you prefer (e.g., 9am–2pm) and how long can you be at the zoo?
5) Are there any dates you must avoid (testing days, holidays, school events)?
6) Is this mostly outdoors (likely yes), and do you want me to factor in weather and suggest the best-weather day within your range?

Once I have those answers, I can propose specific dates and times and check weather suitability for you.</action>
